hero.name: Thaís de Medeiros Moreira
hero.tagline: Bridging Legal Precision with Backend Architecture
description: Former lawyer with a postgraduate degree in Civil Law, now a Python developer focused on backend.

Building Django and PostgreSQL projects with automated testing, Docker and CI/CD. Nine years of legal practice taught me to turn client needs into concrete requirements, the same work I now do against code.

journey.title: Legal Background
journey.description: Bachelor's and Postgraduate degree in Civil Law from PUC Minas. Trained in rigorous problem analysis, documentation, and stakeholder communication.

journey.title: Career Pivot
journey.description: Decided to transition into tech, combining analytical skills from law with passion for programming and problem-solving through code.

journey.title: Focused Learning
journey.description: Completed 25+ technical certifications and currently advancing through Alura's comprehensive Backend Python Career Track, while building hands-on projects of my own.

learning.title: Alura - Backend Python Career Track
learning.description: Comprehensive backend development path covering APIs with Django and Flask, clean architecture, CI/CD, and real-world market challenges.

projects.title: SkillBridge - Freelancer Platform Backend (in progress)
projects.description: First modules of a freelancing-platform backend: accounts and profiles with a custom user model (email login), abstract base models, one-to-one and many-to-many relations, custom validators and admin panel, with check and unique constraints enforced in the database. Covered by 304 automated tests and a four-job GitHub Actions CI: tests against PostgreSQL with a 95% coverage gate, Ruff and strict mypy, Docker image build and full-history secret scanning (Gitleaks). Passwords hashed with Argon2id.

projects.title: Medication Log API (in progress)
projects.description: Delivery path in place before the first feature: multi-stage, non-root production image served by Granian, deployed on Render with Neon PostgreSQL behind a health-check endpoint, with automatic deploys once CI passes. Local environment with Docker Compose (the app only starts when PostgreSQL is healthy) and a three-job CI: lint, formatting and strict type checking; tests against PostgreSQL with a pending-migrations check; and production image build.

projects.title: School Manager API - Django REST Framework
projects.description: REST API with Django REST Framework: CRUD endpoints for students, courses and enrollments, enrollment listings per student and per course, and reusable custom validators (CPF, name, phone) applied at model and serializer level.

projects.title: Alura Space - Django Architecture & Refactor
projects.description: Space-photo gallery built following three Alura Django courses, one per branch (templates, data persistence and admin, forms and authentication). After the courses, I refactored the project on my own initiative: a hierarchical template inheritance structure and reusable partials cut about 70% of duplicated HTML, added search by name and category, and adopted Conventional Commits.

projects.title: SecureBank API - JWT Authentication
projects.description: Flask REST API for user registration, login and balance updates, built following a Rocketseat course. Authentication uses JWT, with a middleware that checks the token's user against the request. I replaced the course's bcrypt with Argon2 for password hashing. Includes unit tests with Pytest.

projects.title: Clean Code Flask API
projects.description: REST API with Flask organized in layers: controllers, repositories, views and validators. Uses interfaces and dependency injection, custom HTTP exceptions, input validation, and unit tests for controllers and the repository. Built following a course on clean code, MVC and SOLID.

projects.title: NLW Operator - Computer Vision
projects.description: Advanced computer vision monorepo featuring a LeNet-5 CNN implementation for MNIST, a custom gesture recognition lab with MediaPipe and YOLO, and a real-time web application built with FastHTML and WebSockets for low-latency video processing.
